title: register_agent grants
description: The p_grants argument of basalt_meta.register_agent and update_agent (jsonb): the tables and privileges asked for the new agent. Each privilege must be held by the agent's level at table level (has_table_privilege on the enrolled role's oid); asking for more is refused with BS012 PRIVILEGE_NOT_HELD. CONTRACT.md, Access and audit, Registering an agent.

table.description: schema.table as Postgres quotes it (quote_ident on each part).
